skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake', upload checklist row 'Revenue by customer by month, or the invoice list with customer, date and amount' does not say the list must reach back to each customer's first-ever invoice, nor that it must include unpaid invoices. A 12-month paid-invoice history satisfies the checklist as written yet makes 'first invoice' the window edge and turns unpaid recent invoices into apparent churn. Add: 'covering each customer's full history, paid and unpaid'.

references/edge-cases.md 'History does not reach far enough' is framed as Mosofin-specific (a recently added connector); the same left-censoring applies on the upload path and should be stated for uploads too.
sample_defects: customer_payment_history_12m.csv: all 12 customers' first invoices fall on 2024-10-10 or 2024-11-10 (the first two months of the window) and none is acquired afterwards, while monthly_profit_and_loss_36m.csv shows 282,000 revenue in 2022-10. The cohort analysis the manifest expects ('Builds cohorts from first invoice') is therefore degenerate: 2 cohorts, 0 acquisitions in 10 months, CAC = spend / 0.

Customer invoices do not tie to P&L revenue: 2,801,789 / 4,203,800 = 66.6% for Oct 2024 - Jul 2025, and no invoices for Aug-Sep 2025 against 477,100 + 455,400 = 932,500 of revenue. If intended, add it to expect.findings; if not, regenerate.
